explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 117 named tracks and releases across Boomkat's September 15 current and preorder pages, artist and label Bandcamp catalogues, current compilation framing and adjacent catalogue paths. Written attributed descriptions and exact listings only; no audio audition.
exclusions: The canonical ledger, annotations, journey map, discussion and revisit queues, rejected and discovery histories, inspiration files, publication state and repository-wide Discovery Pool were audited first. UTF-8, JSON, count, map-order, receipt and protected-order checks passed; no objective defect, listener authorization, triggered revisit or unfinished repair required REPAIR.

Every canonical, previously evaluated, active PARKED, placement-specific REJECT, unresolved exact identity and repository-wide utility identity was excluded. Nine fresh exact-title leads from nine releases remain.
The recurring-PARK evidence guard was applied: one track per release, with exact-track prose or an exact artist/label-hosted listing for every lead.

Planned boundaries were compared with Runs 270-274. No boundary evaluated in those five completed discovery runs was reused. Failed Run 276 ended before identity resolution because of invalid ledger-URI transcription and supplies no musical evidence.
Generic preorders, prestige-only reissues, persistent identities and tracks supported only by genre labels were inspected but excluded.
Source prose is attributed rather than measured. Neither listener-protected handoff is split.
Rank reflects evidence specificity, selection-lens relevance, canonical potential and information gain, not novelty, orthodoxy, diversity, technical cleverness, prestige or a fixed chapter map.
